method.cache: Warm OS/DB cache; no cache flush or DB restart
method.timing: Client wall time through full fetch/decode; excludes hashing and EXPLAIN
method.connections: One reused local connection per DB; PostgreSQL auto-prepare disabled
method.baseline: Primary-key indexes retained; secondary workload indexes removed only from copies

definition.sql:
SELECT r.campaign_number, r.report_date, r.summary
FROM "bench_393f2a545a1a472ca185b43928426da4"."recall_vehicle" rv JOIN "bench_393f2a545a1a472ca185b43928426da4"."recall" r ON r.recall_id=rv.recall_id
WHERE rv.model_year_id=%s
ORDER BY r.report_date DESC NULLS LAST, r.campaign_number

SELECT rr.source_record_id, r.campaign_number, rr.component, rr.manufacturing_started, rr.manufacturing_ended
FROM "bench_393f2a545a1a472ca185b43928426da4"."recall_record" rr JOIN "bench_393f2a545a1a472ca185b43928426da4"."recall" r ON r.recall_id=rr.recall_id
WHERE rr.model_year_id=%s AND rr.component=%s
ORDER BY rr.source_record_id LIMIT 20
